title: How LLM Agents Reshape Financial Knowledge Graphs: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2611.33584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial knowledge graphs (KGs) link information across sources to support risk assessment, investment research, asset recommendations, and forecasting. Large language models (LLMs) help build these graphs by extracting relationships from text and matching entities across records. Yet a workflow may still prescribe which sources to consult and which checks to run. If the chosen sources lack relevant evidence, even accurate extraction can leave a financial question unanswered. LLM agents can adapt the workflow as evidence emerges. They use the graph and earlier findings to decide where to look next, which claims to verify, and whether to update a record for later use. This is the first survey devoted to how LLM agents reshape the construction, maintenance, and use of financial KGs. Our taxonomy covers Knowledge Graph Construction, Temporal Evolution, Verification, Reconciliation, and Admission, Adaptive Acquisition, and Knowledge Graph U

translated_title: 大语言模型智能体如何重塑金融知识图谱：综述
translated_abstract: 金融知识图谱（KGs）通过跨数据源关联信息，以支持风险评估、投资研究、资产推荐和预测等任务。大语言模型（LLMs）能够通过从文本中抽取关系以及跨记录匹配实体来辅助构建这些图谱。然而，现有工作流程可能仍然预先规定了要查询哪些数据源以及执行哪些核查步骤。如果所选数据源缺乏相关证据，即使抽取过程十分准确，金融问题仍可能无法得到解答。LLM智能体则能够随着证据的出现自适应地调整工作流程：它们利用图谱和已有发现来决定下一步查找哪里、验证哪些断言，以及是否更新记录以供后续使用。这是第一篇专门探讨LLM智能体如何重塑金融知识图谱的构建、维护与使用的综述。本文的分类体系涵盖知识图谱构建、时间演化、验证、对账与准入、自适应获取以及知识图谱使用等方面。
tldr: 本文是首篇专门探讨大语言模型智能体如何重塑金融知识图谱构建、维护与使用的综述，提出了涵盖图谱构建、时间演化、验证与对账准入、自适应获取及图谱应用等环节的系统分类框架。
en_tdlr: This is the first survey on how LLM agents reshape the construction, maintenance, and use of financial knowledge graphs, offering a taxonomy covering construction, temporal evolution, verification, reconciliation and admission, and adaptive acquisition.
